content_disjoint_rule: Before opening label values or model outcomes, remove every successor content identity appearing in any V3 SWIFT review and every identity appearing in more than one selected successor review; freeze the remaining per-review identities and counts.
custody_boundary: Public same-session download and execution; no independent custody or external execution claim.
outcome_boundary: Headers, identifiers, titles and abstracts may be processed label-blind for binding. label_included values, positive counts, seeds and all active-order outcomes remain unopened until source, population, protocol and implementation freezes exist.
retention_rule: No selected review may be deleted after source download or outcomes. Any selected review that cannot bind source, content, both classes, or execution makes the new V5 identity CANNOT_CHECK.
selection_rule: Select the five SYNERGY V1 review decisions with the largest publisher-documented record counts. Break ties by ascending review identity. The rule uses no inclusion count, label value, text content, or model outcome.
